_comment: Main settings. site_url is the address the site is published at. For your own domain later, change it to e.g. https://www.yourdomain.com and run: python3 build.py

business._comment: Fill these in only after the Google Business Profile address is verified, then set address_verified to true. Until then no address, map or LocalBusiness data is published.

analytics._comment: Use one of the two: a GA4 measurement ID (G-XXXXXXX) or a Google Tag Manager container ID (GTM-XXXXXXX).
